comparison.scope: All pixels decoded and all PTS checked. Motion aesthetics are reviewed separately; timing checks alone do not establish natural motion.

motion_curves.derivatives: cyclic forward finite differences at evaluated 60Hz poses; terminal duplicate excluded
motion_curves.limits_are: production regression thresholds, not medical ideals

authored_continuity.method: one-sided fourth-degree extrapolation of 5 points, phase steps .002/.001/.0005/.00025; derivative units use true cycle duration
authored_continuity.precision: best resolved difference across stencils; Blender Vector/Quaternion components are float32, so acceleration differences include numerical noise
authored_continuity.note: This tests joins of authored functions, separate from finite 60Hz motion and FK/IK. Support pressure-centre sample travel is reported, not treated as skin-point slip.
